premise: As the sun sets and night comes, the quietest friends of the rock pool get ready for sleep: Urchin wiggles, Clam closes up, and Seaweed leans over them like a blanket.
inspiration: The bedtime round of nursery rhyme (goodnight to each one in turn), set in a rock pool, ending under a soft green blanket.

en-US.title: The Quietest Friends
en-US.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] The sun was going down over the rock pool, gold and pink. {urchin:enter} {urchin:go to pool} Urchin yawned a little purple yawn. {urchin:face happy} {urchin:live wiggle} He wiggled his soft spines, one last wiggle. [whispers] Goodnight, Urchin, said Clam. {clam:face happy} {clam:live peek} She opened up wide, showed her pearl to the evening sky, and closed again, snug and tight. Seaweed swayed, slow… slow… {seaweed:face sleeping} [short pause] {canvas:night 0.8 40s} Night came softly. The moon looked down into the water. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish waved one sleepy arm. {starfish:live wave} Goodnight, everyone. {urchin:live sleep hold} Urchin closed his eyes. {clam:face sleeping} Clam closed hers. {seaweed:live sway hold} And Seaweed leaned over her quiet little friends, gentle as a blanket. [long pause] [whispers] {starfish:face sleeping} Shhh. The rock pool is sleeping. Goodnight.

[long pause] [whispers] {starfish:face sleeping} Chist. La charca está dormida. Buenas noches.

ja-JP.title: しずかな なかまたち
ja-JP.text: {clam:enter}{seaweed:enter}{canvas:sunset 0.8 25s}[softly]潮だまりの上で、お日さまが、きんいろとピンクにしずんでいきます。{urchin:enter}{urchin:go to pool}ウニくんが、ちいさなむらさきのあくび。ふわぁ。{urchin:face happy}{urchin:live wiggle}やわらかいとげを、さいごに、ふりふり。[whispers]「おやすみ、ウニくん」 と貝さん。{clam:face happy}{clam:live peek}ぱかっとひらいて、ゆうやけ空にしんじゅを見せると、また、ぴたっ。ぬくぬくです。海藻は、ゆらり…ゆらり…{seaweed:face sleeping}[short pause]{canvas:night 0.8 40s}そっと、よるがきました。お月さまが、水をのぞきこみます。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}ヒトデさんが、ねむそうに、うでを一本ふりました。{starfish:live wave}「みんな、おやすみ」 {urchin:live sleep hold}ウニくんが、目をとじました。{clam:face sleeping}貝さんも、目をとじました。{seaweed:live sway hold}海藻は、しずかななかまたちに、もうふみたいに、そうっとかぶさりました。[pause][whispers]{starfish:face sleeping}しーっ。潮だまりは、おねむです。おやすみ。

de-DE.title: Die leisesten Freunde
de-DE.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] Über dem Tümpel ging die Sonne unter, golden und rosa. {urchin:enter} {urchin:go to pool} Der Seeigel gähnte ein kleines, lila Gähnen. {urchin:face happy} {urchin:live wiggle} Er wackelte mit seinen weichen Stacheln, ein letztes Mal. [whispers] „Gute Nacht, Seeigel“, sagte die Muschel. {clam:face happy} {clam:live peek} Sie klappte weit auf, zeigte dem Abendhimmel ihre Perle und machte sich wieder zu, fest und gemütlich. Der Seetang wiegte sich, langsam… langsam… {seaweed:face sleeping} [short pause] {canvas:night 0.8 40s} Leise kam die Nacht. Der Mond schaute hinunter ins Wasser. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Der Seestern winkte mit einem müden Arm. {starfish:live wave} „Gute Nacht, ihr alle.“ {urchin:live sleep hold} Der Seeigel machte die Augen zu. {clam:face sleeping} Die Muschel auch. {seaweed:live sway hold} Und der Seetang beugte sich über seine stillen kleinen Freunde, sanft wie eine Decke. [pause] [whispers] {starfish:face sleeping} Pssst. Der Tümpel schläft. Gute Nacht.

fr-FR.title: Les amis silencieux
fr-FR.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] Le soleil se couchait sur la mare, tout doré, tout rose. {urchin:enter} {urchin:go to pool} Oursin a bâillé un petit bâillement violet. {urchin:face happy} {urchin:live wiggle} Il a remué ses piquants tout doux, une dernière fois. [whispers] « Bonne nuit, Oursin », a dit Palourde. {clam:face happy} {clam:live peek} Elle s’est ouverte en grand, elle a montré sa perle au ciel du soir, puis elle s’est refermée, bien au chaud. Algue se balançait, lentement… lentement… {seaweed:face sleeping} [short pause] {canvas:night 0.8 40s} La nuit est arrivée tout doucement. [pause] [whispers] {starfish:face sleeping} Chut. La mare dort. Bonne nuit.

it-IT.text: {clam:enter} {seaweed:enter} {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] Il sole tramontava sulla pozza, tutto oro e rosa. {urchin:enter} {urchin:go to pool} Riccio ha fatto un piccolo sbadiglio viola. {urchin:face happy} {urchin:live wiggle} Ha mosso i suoi aculei morbidi, un'ultima volta. zh-TW.title: 最安靜的好朋友
zh-TW.text: {clam:enter}{seaweed:enter}{canvas:sunset 0.8 25s}[softly]太陽慢慢落下，潮池染成了金色和粉紅色。{urchin:enter}{urchin:go to pool}海膽打了一個小小的、紫紫的呵欠。{urchin:face happy}{urchin:live wiggle}牠搖搖軟軟的刺，最後再搖一下。[whispers]「晚安，海膽。」 蛤蜊說。{clam:face happy}{clam:live peek}牠把殼張得大大的，讓傍晚的天空看看牠的珍珠，再輕輕闔上，關得緊緊的、暖暖的。海草慢慢地搖……慢慢地搖……{seaweed:face sleeping}[short pause]{canvas:night 0.8 40s}夜晚輕輕地來了。月亮低頭看著水裡。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星揮揮一隻想睡的手。{starfish:live wave}「大家晚安。」 {urchin:live sleep hold}海膽閉上眼睛。{clam:face sleeping}蛤蜊也閉上了。{seaweed:live sway hold}海草彎下身子，輕輕蓋著她安安靜靜的小朋友們，像一條軟軟的被子。[pause][whispers]{starfish:face sleeping}噓——潮池睡著了。晚安。

zh-HK.text: {clam:enter}{seaweed:enter}{canvas:sunset 0.8 25s}[softly]太陽在石池那邊慢慢落下，把天空染得金黃又粉紅。{urchin:enter}{urchin:go to pool}海膽打了一個小小的、紫色的呵欠。{urchin:face happy}{urchin:live wiggle}牠搖搖軟軟的刺，最後再搖一次。[whispers]「海膽，早唞。」 蜆說。{clam:face happy}{clam:live peek}牠把殼張得大大的，讓黃昏的天空看看牠的珍珠，然後又合上，關得緊緊的，暖暖的。海草慢慢地搖……搖……{seaweed:face sleeping}[short pause]{canvas:night 0.8 40s}夜晚輕輕地來了。月亮靜靜地望進水裏。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星睡眼惺忪，揮了揮一隻手。{starfish:live wave}「大家，早唞。」 {urchin:live sleep hold}海膽閉上了眼睛。{clam:face sleeping}蜆也閉上了。{seaweed:live sway hold}海草彎下身來，蓋着她安安靜靜的小朋友，溫柔得像一張被子。[pause][whispers]{starfish:face sleeping}噓。石池睡着了。早唞。
